name: Nimbus Strike

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Wukong dashes to the target enemy's location and sends out untargetable clones to strike up to two additional enemies near the target's location, dealing magic damage.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Wukong dashes to the target enemy's location and sends out untargetable clones to strike up to two additional enemies near the target's location, dealing magic damage.
Active: Wukong dashes to the target enemy's location and sends out untargetable clones to strike up to two additional enemies near the target's location, dealing magic damage.

parts.text: Upon arrival, Wukong gains bonus attack speed for 5 seconds.
Crushing Blow can be cast during the dash.

notes: Casting Nimbus Strike interrupts the attack windup of enemies targeting Wukong.
Nimbus Strike has an offset distance of 75 units from the target dashed to.
The ability applies a stack of Electrocute even if the target is untargetable.

text: Some effects cause a basic attack to have an uncancellable windup. Unlike normal basic attacks and similar to the cast time of a spell, the windup of these attacks cannot be interrupted by neither the user themselves nor any status effect, other than death, polymorph, Quinn's Vault, Hextech Rocketbelt Supersonic, and in some cases, untargetability and range.

Any effect that would disrupt an attack's windup, aside from the ones noted above, are ignored by basic attacks with uncancellable windups. If the attack doesn't lock out other abilities, they may be used normally, and the basic attack will hit during the ability cast.

name: Stone Skin

parts.label: Innate
parts.text:
Innate: Wukong gains 6 – 10 (based on level) bonus armor and regenerates an additional 0.35% of his maximum health every 5 seconds.

Whenever Wukong or his clone damage an enemy champion or monster with his basic attacks or abilities, he generates a stack of Strength of Stone for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 5 times. Stacks expire one by one every second when the duration ends.

mechanics.evidence: Innate: Wukong gains 6 – 10 (based on level) bonus armor and regenerates an additional 0.35% of his maximum health every 5 seconds.

values.context: Innate: Wukong gains 6 – 10 (based on level) bonus armor and regenerates an additional 0.35% of his maximum health every 5 seconds.

parts.label: Strength of Stone

name: Crushing Blow

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Wukong empowers his next basic attack within 5 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain bonus range, deal bonus physical damage and then inflict armor reduction for 3 seconds.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Wukong empowers his next basic attack within 5 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain bonus range, deal bonus physical damage and then inflict armor reduction for 3 seconds.

parts.text: Crushing Blow's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds whenever Wukong or his clone damage an enemy.
Crushing Blow resets Wukong's and his clone's basic attack timer. Other abilities can be used during the attack's animation.

mechanics.evidence: Crushing Blow resets Wukong's and his clone's basic attack timer.

notes: The basic attack portion of Crushing Blow is tagged as both basic damage and spell damage, while the bonus damage portion is proc damage.
Crushing Blow triggers on structures and wards but the armor reduction is not applied.

Issuing a Hold command (default J) or Stop command (default S) after Crushing Blow's attack has started will cancel the animation, however the attack will still be launched and Wukong will be unable to move until that point.

name: Cyclone

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Wukong spins his staff around for up to 2 seconds, becoming ghosted and gaining 20% bonus movement speed. The staff deals physical damage every 0.25 seconds to enemies hit, and can knock them up once for 0.6 seconds. Cyclone will not knock up enemies who were already hit by either Wukong or his clone within the same cast.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Wukong spins his staff around for up to 2 seconds, becoming ghosted and gaining 20% bonus movement speed.
The staff deals physical damage every 0.25 seconds to enemies hit, and can knock them up once for 0.6 seconds.
Cyclone will not knock up enemies who were already hit by either Wukong or his clone within the same cast.

parts.text: Cyclone can be recast after 0.5 seconds within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or by casting another ability.

parts.label: Recast
parts.text: Recast: Wukong ends Cyclone. After 1 second, he can cast Cyclone a second time within 8 seconds of the first cast.
Nimbus Strike bonus attack speed duration is continuously refreshed while spinning.
Cyclone's damage is capped at 200 / 400 / 600 (based on level) per second against monsters.

values.context: Cyclone's damage is capped at 200 / 400 / 600 (based on level) per second against monsters.

notes: Cyclone is special cased to grant stacks of Conqueror for each tick of damage.

Casting a basic ability will always interrupt Wukong's Cyclone. A clone can be interrupted by casting Crushing Blow, but only if the clone was made during the current Cyclone cast and only for that cast. This means if both Wukong and his clone are spinning, the clone cannot be interrupted.
Cyclone's remaining duration always stays the same even after the clone replicated the ability.
During Cyclone, Wukong and his clone's attack ranges are reduced to 50 .

Spell shield will block one instance of damage.
  - Blocking the knock up will still grant immunity to it from either of Cyclone's casts.

name: Warrior Trickster

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Wukong enters invisibility for 1 second and dashes in the target direction, leaving behind a clone of himself at his casting position for 4 seconds.

mechanics.evidence: Active: Wukong enters invisibility for 1 second and dashes in the target direction, leaving behind a clone of himself at his casting position for 4 seconds.
Active: Wukong enters invisibility for 1 second and dashes in the target direction, leaving behind a clone of himself at his casting position for 4 seconds.
Active: Wukong enters invisibility for 1 second and dashes in the target direction, leaving behind a clone of himself at his casting position for 4 seconds.

parts.text: The clone is untargetable to allies and can basic attack autonomously, prioritizing the last enemy Wukong damaged. It can also gain the effects of Crushing Blow and Nimbus Strike bonus attack speed, and casts Cyclone whenever Wukong does.

mechanics.evidence: The clone is untargetable to allies and can basic attack autonomously, prioritizing the last enemy Wukong damaged.

parts.text: See Pets for more details about Wukong's clone. Wukong can cast any of his abilities during the dash.

notes: Casting Warrior Trickster during an ability's effects will transfer them to the clone.
Turret shots instantly kill the clone.
The clone is immune to stasis and Blast Cone.
The clone can still be targeted by allied auto-targeted effects (e.g. Heal, Celestial Blessing).
Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.
